items.headline: $MON Hits Record Low as Insider Unlock Looms
items.summary: About 16.6B $MON became eligible for release, roughly 1.4x pre-unlock supply, pressuring Monad’s token to a record low. #MON

items.headline: $LQTY: Liquity V2 ETH Branch Enters Safety Mode
items.summary: Liquity said its V2 ETH branch fell near 149% collateralization, under the 150% threshold that restricts withdrawals and new debt. #LQTY

items.headline: $ETH Foundation Doubles Security Team on AI Risk
items.summary: Ethereum Foundation is doubling its security team as AI-driven risks grow, a notable ecosystem hardening move for $ETH. #ETH

items.headline: Kalshi Sees Utah Move to Drop Criminal Charges
items.summary: Utah’s AG moved to drop charges without prejudice after Kalshi halted operations, leaving refiling possible if it returns.

items.headline: $BTC Spared as France Rejects €100K Wallet Rule
items.summary: France’s Senate rejected a €100,000 crypto wallet rule and stablecoin-swap tax ideas, easing near-term pressure for $BTC holders. #BTC
